title: Rollers footer
description: A charcoal footer with a faint sawtooth texture: a big orange mark over a bold white wordmark, a spaced uppercase sign-off on the right with every other word in orange, then hairline-ruled rows of link columns and depot addresses under orange uppercase headings, and the legal line. Links turn orange on hover; the rules draw in.
notes: dark in both modes: it uses the theme's .dark palette on itself
name: rollers-footer

props.name: mark
props.description: the large mark above the wordmark; an orange roller-drum icon by default

props.name: tagline
props.description: the sign-off on the right, word by word; every other word is orange

props.name: groups
props.description: link columns (four on wide screens, two on phones)

props.name: depots
props.description: depot addresses (five on wide screens, two on phones)

props.name: credit
props.description: a link on the right of the bottom row (privacy, credits)
